classification.difficultyReason: Count the edges incident to each vertex and identify the odd degrees.

content.prompt: How many vertices of odd degree does this network have?

spec.description: Five unlabelled vertices and seven undirected edges; source blue ordinary edges and vertex markers are rendered black under house style. Coordinate names are internal and do not print.
spec.mathematics: Positional vertices A=far upper left, B=lower left, C=upper middle-right, D=lower middle-right, E=far right. Edges AB, AC, BC, BD, CD, CE, DE. Degrees are respectively 2, 3, 4, 3, 2.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the unlabelled network is visible in the question; degrees and answer remain in solutions.

answer.worked: The degrees are 2 at the far upper-left vertex, 3 at the lower-left vertex, 4 at the upper middle-right vertex, 3 at the lower middle-right vertex and 2 at the far-right vertex. The two vertices of degree 3 have odd degree, so there are 2 vertices of odd degree.
